subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 7.
solution:
The correct answer is 'and.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When we use** because**, we are focusing on the reason.
 
• जब हम **because **उपयोग करते हैं क्योंकि, हम कारण पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर रहे हैं।
 
 
• **Example**: *She spoke quietly **because** she didn't want Catherine to hear.*
 
 
 
• ​**But** is used to introduce an added statement, usually something that is different from what you have said before.
 
• **But **का उपयोग एक अतिरिक्त कथन को पेश करने के लिए किया जाता है, आमतौर पर कुछ ऐसा जो आपके द्वारा पहले कही गई बातों से अलग होता है।
 
 
• **Example**: *She's very hard-working **but **not very imaginative.*
 
 
 
• **​And** is used to join two words, phrases, parts of sentences, or related statements together.
 
• **And** दो शब्दों, वाक्यांशों, वाक्यों के हिस्सों या संबंधित कथनों को एक साथ जोड़ने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• **Example**: *We kissed **and** hugged each other.*
 
 
 
• *​***So** is* *used at the beginning of a sentence to connect it with something that has been said or has happened previously.
 
• **So**, एक वाक्य की शुरुआत में इसे किसी ऐसी चीज से जोड़ने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो पहले कही गई है या हो चुकी है।
 
 
• **Example**: *So, just to finish what I was saying earlier.*
 
 
 
• *​​*Therefore, the correct answer is 'and.'
 
• The correct phrase: .*....... **getting jobs, **and** it came to me: dogs," says Bergin, ............*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In grammar, a **conjunction** is a word or group of words that joins together words, groups, or clauses.
 
• In English, there are co-ordinating conjunctions such as** 'and' and 'but'**, and subordinating conjunctions such as **'although', 'because', and 'when'.**
